cost_basis: every v14 cell of the three identities, completed and failed; a timed-out call's cost is unknown to the kernel and not counted, so the total is a lower bound; the full-trajectory gates are the first world of each run and are included

privacy_boundary.excluded: raw provider responses, model reasoning, complete receipts, failure messages, provider identifiers, and the kernel trajectory grain (see README)
privacy_boundary.included: contracts, the pack, per-cell numeric outcomes with typed failure conditions, receipt digests, the declared analysis computed
